name: Mage Tracker (Sentry Form Only)
description: The creature emits a pulse of energy that helps it better locate its magical quarry. Each creature within 120 feet of the creature that has the ability to cast spells must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be mystically marked by the creature for 1 hour. While marked, a creature can’t become hidden from the creature and gains no benefit from the invisible condition against the creature. Additionally, while a marked creature is on the same plane of existence as the creature, the creature always knows the distance and direction to the creature.
